promotion.basis: WS8 implementation validation passed and every remaining evidence boundary is explicit in limitations

evidence.residualDcTopology: Mizusaki adsorption/desorption reduction with explicit drive polarity
evidence.residualDcParameters: Mizusaki laboratory-cell midpoint rates with normalized project bridge priors
evidence.scanTiming: exact GBA raster timing plus unselected AGS-101 latch, delay, parity, and inversion candidate sets
evidence.gtgRuntime: continuous first-order rate field using the WS4 nominal literature-constrained table with analytic missing-corner fallback
evidence.aperture: unit-mean lcd-grid-v2-derived generic analytic prior with narrow/nominal/wide WS6 sensitivity variants; no AGS-specific archival kernel
evidence.backlight: two user brightness modes established; ratio, absolute luminance, topology, DC/PWM behavior, frequency, duty, phase, and uniformity unresolved
evidence.exposureIntegration: exact native-frame first-order emitted-light integral partitioned at the WS3 optical event; endpoint feedback remains separate
evidence.retentionExcitation: per-pixel RGB555-command and WS3 polarity/topology proxy multiplying the normalized DriveDcOffset; no displayed-luma input or voltage claim
evidence.publicColorAdapter: HCS measured 32-code EOTF and native-to-sRGB color stage with separately named black-subtracted and physical-measured-black outputs
evidence.staticColorEvidence: HCS instrument measurement record embedded through deterministic local derivation

measured: HCS neutral ramp, black/white anchors, and full-level RGB/CMY patches

GBA row timing and top-to-bottom scan direction

line-center latch offset and zero independent optical delay as legacy candidates, not formal AGS-101 constants
even-positive parity and frame-global inversion as legacy runtime candidates, with alternate hypotheses generated for sensitivity testing
WS4 near-transition and mid-gray distance-penalty magnitudes
WS5 RGB555 code and polarity sensitivity weights
WS6 aperture radius variants and 0.5/0.75/1.0 relative-backlight sensitivity sweep
WS7 host-interval classifications and endpoint presentation diagnostic

diagnostics.presetPackaging: self-contained full presets generated by tools/build-ags101-ws1.mjs
diagnostics.safeBypass: Set TemporalResponse=0, DriveRetention=0, SpatialRetention=0, BakedScanout=0, and ExposureMode=0 when causal frontend semantics are unavailable

limitations: The cited records contain no AGS-101 per-transition gray-to-gray response matrix

The default WS4 nominal table is a Sharp-family literature-constrained reconstruction with zero measured AGS-101 cells; exact-panel response, channel differences, brightness dependence, temperature dependence, overshoot, and gray-distance magnitude remain unresolved
The checked-in synthetic GtG table is a test-only pipeline fixture and is not used by the normal preset
The default retention rates come from a contemporary laboratory TFT-LCD cell rather than an unused AGS-101; normalized drive offset and drive-to-code coupling are auditable project bridge priors

WS5 can produce per-pixel pattern-history state from raw RGB555 code and candidate polarity, but its code/polarity weights are unfitted sensitivity priors and equal-mean chromatic commands share one scalar state
The WS2 capture loopback is synthetic pipeline validation and is not AGS-101 panel evidence
HCS protocol metadata does not record brightness level, ambient lighting, warm-up, charger state, or panel label

HCS coverage has no per-channel ramps, intermediate mixed patches, repeats, absolute peak-luminance context, or inter-unit variation; generated RGB555 combinations are modeled outputs, not separate measurements

AGS-101 backlight topology, low/high luminance ratio, DC/PWM behavior, modulation frequency/duty/phase, LED layout, and spatial uniformity remain unknown; the optional relative-gain sweep is sensitivity-only
No calibrated overlay-separated LQ029B1DC01F aperture image was recovered, so the runtime aperture remains an explicitly generic lcd-grid-v2-derived prior rather than an AGS-specific optical kernel

WS7 advances exactly one native panel frame per Shader execution; frontend-generated duplicates, skipped fast-forward frames, and unknown VRR duplication/drop histories cannot be reconstructed and require the safe bypass
Save-state load does not serialize PassFeedback0; current GtG and retained-DC history therefore restart or require the stateless safe bypass rather than being restored
The KONKR target exposes only fixed 960x640 at 60 Hz, so stateful behavior under actual VRR remains unvalidated; the WS8 target receipt validates only the stateless boundary for unknown intervals
WS7 integrates unity and static relative-backlight sensitivity only; PWM/DC temporal modulation remains unavailable because topology, frequency, duty, and phase are unresolved
The neutral sRGB adapter is a regression baseline, not the measured AGS-101 color stage documented by AGS-COLOR-01

GBA raster timing is exact; AGS-101 latch phase, pure optical delay, polarity phase, inversion topology, and brightness coupling remain unselected hypotheses because no direct AGT-CPU-01 trace or exact LQ029B1DC01F specification was found
Retention feedback is valid only for normal forward TotalSubFrames=1 rendering; rewind, run-ahead, and dropped fast-forward time are not reconstructed
